newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: U.S. pilot seized with heroin at Colombia airport.
newsitem.headline: U.S. pilot seized with heroin at Colombia airport.

text.p: Police arrested a U.S. pilot carrying a suitcase packed with at least 11 pounds (5 kg) of high grade heroin at Bogota's international airport on Sunday evening, a police spokeswman said.

Bradley Dale, 40, was detained as he made his way to board one of the Colombian airline's ACES flights to Panama City, the spokeswoman said. She said he was travelling on the flight as a passenger but was wearing a commercial aviator's uniform when arrested. No hometown was given.
The spokeswoman said Dale told police he worked for a U.S. airline but did not say which one.

"Dale was arrested with a suitcase stuffed with clothes and high quality heroin," the spokeswoman said. "The luggage weighed a total of 26 pounds (12 kg). Full checks are still being carried out but there was at least 11 pounds (5 kg) of heroin," she added.
Earlier in the day airport police seized a Mexican passenger as he tried to board a flight to Mexico City with false-bottomed suitcases packed with 93 pounds (42 kg) of cocaine.

The U.S Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA) estimates Colombian drug cartels supply at least 80 percent of the world's cocaine. And in a report late last year, it said Colombia had edged out the Golden Triangle of southeast Asia as the No. 1 supplier of high grade heroin to the United States.
